protocol.relationship_to_default: student score-gradient policy comparison; R04 and QH defaults unchanged

normalizer.source: embedded in the pinned q0 checkpoint

strategy.beta_calibration: q0 no-update pilot; freeze before round 0

replay.record: one scored center with its fixed 64-direction score gradient

parallelism.collection: two independent one-GPU ranks, 32 centers each; one BatchCoilFieldGpu with 128 endpoints per valid center
parallelism.training: two-GPU DDP, 10 global optimizer steps per round; each step samples 32 records per rank from the synchronized replay pool

baseline.relationship: direct schedule comparison; all sampling, replay, loss, scorer, optimizer, and model settings are inherited from replay50

strategy.gradient: one ABI-11 R04-compatible 64-direction centered finite-difference query per valid center
strategy.gradient_coordinate_map: exact geometry diagonal map plus central-difference current L1 canonicalization Jacobian
strategy.beta_calibration: inherited frozen q0 no-update pilot from replay50

replay.record: one scored center with its fixed 64-direction score gradient
replay.append: newest records appended each round; oldest records evicted after capacity

parallelism.collection: two independent one-GPU ranks; each rank scores 32 centers and runs each center's 128 gradient endpoints in one batched native query
parallelism.training: two-GPU DDP; each of 10 updates samples 32 records per rank from the synchronized replay pool and uses the unchanged loss
parallelism.serial_reason: a center must pass its own native validity and endpoint-consistency gates before its gradient is usable; independent centers are split across ranks

protocol.relationship_to_default: Analytic-prior online Flow exploration; current QH default is unchanged.

adam20.axis_policy: screen globally, then reuse the selected axis from optimizer step 0
adam20.replay_target: all formal centers from step 0 through step 20

update.replay_policy: FIFO over whole rollouts; valid rollouts have 21 centers and invalid rollouts retain step 0
update.trajectory_batch_rule: base batch multiplied by ceiling(mean replay points per rollout), capped at 21x

parallelism.serial_reason: Flow q(k+1) depends on the complete scored Adam20 batch from q(k)

distillation.initialization: fresh; no checkpoint, normalizer, or replay state from the 0.12 m experiment
distillation.convergence: validation plateau plus three stable generated-distribution checks
distillation.maximum_epochs: 5000 is a failing runaway guard only

evaluator.scope: the same frozen R04 library is used for q0 audit, screening, Adam20 gradient endpoints, formal centers, and replay scores

online_round.valid_rollout: store all 21 formal centers from Adam step 0 through step 20
online_round.invalid_rollout: store the represented step-0 start and skip Adam
online_round.trajectory_batch: base batch times ceil(mean(points per replay rollout)), at most 21x; microbatch 256; one optimizer step after full accumulation

resources.teacher_generation: one P107 two-GPU job uses 8 CPU workers
resources.distillation_and_online: two P107 RTX5090 GPUs and 8 CPU cores
resources.stop: one-hour wall reserve or STOP_AFTER_ROUND sentinel
